page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top centre-right; page number at top left. Catchword "Quid" at bottom right.

main_text.l: nihil cohæret. Idcò crebrò dici solet: simile non est
idem: omnis similitudo claudicat. Item, simile non
currit quatuor pedibus. Similitudo nihil probat.
Dissimile,
[illegible, ~2 words] est comparatum, quod
cum altero dissimili diversam qualitatem habet: ut,
Reges Gentium dominantur, primum dissimile: Chri-
sti autem discipuli non sic,alterum dissimile.
Juris Tyrones initio Institutiones discant,primum
dissimile: non autem Digesta, Codicem, Novellas,
alterum dissimile.
Si Christus regibus gentium dominandi potesta-
tem concedit, non autem suis discipulis: sequitur il-
los Doctores rectè facere, qui seculare brachium ma-
gistratui remittunt: Papam verò Romanum, qui vult
Christi discipulus esse, Cardinales, Episcopos & re-
liquos Papæ gregales graviter peccare, qui, officio
verbi Divini annuntiandi relicto, gladium secularem
portant, cibis opiparis, vinoq; optimo sese ingurgi-
tant, chartis luforiis tempus transfigentes, Veneri fru-
ges & munera sacra libando inserviunt. At verum An-
tecedens ex Luca 22. Ergo & Consequens.
Si juris Tyrones initio Institutiones discant, non
autem Digesta, Codicem, Novellas: sequitur eos, qui-
bus imperatoris admonitio cordi est, rectè facere: re-
liquos verò, qui juris cunabulis repudiatis, vasto Di-
gestorum, Codicis & Novellarum Oceano se temerè
committunt, & Imperatori non audientes esse, & suis
non satis prudenter consulere studiis. At verum Ante-
cedens ex Constitut.
Omnem, verf. Itaque, de juris do-
cendi ratione. Consequens igitur.
Horum syllogismorum ratio est: quia de dissimi-
libus diversum est judicium.

page.notes: The page number is printed "196" in a decorative numeral style; read as 196. The heading "Dissimile" and the words "rectè", "Papam verò" carry printed accents or ligatures as shown. The word(s) after "Dissimile," at the start of the first full paragraph are too smudged to read and are marked illegible. The word "seculare" is at the line end and its final letter is not certain. The line "Quid" is a catchword in italic at bottom right.
